svg.aria-label: ST displacement: first find QRS end and a reliable baseline

g.text: ST displacement: first find QRS end and a reliable baseline
Each row: 3 seconds. Same represented 25 mm/s and 10 mm/mV scale.
B: ST elevation at the J point
C: ST depression at the J point
A single illustrated change is not a STEMI diagnosis. Compare contiguous leads and context.
Original teaching schematic. Not a patient ECG or a diagnostic simulator.
